research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Boom Supersonic is researching composite integrated riblets for drag reduction, propulsion system architecture with variable airflow capture, and dissimilarly shaped aircraft nozzles with tandem mixing devices. Efforts also include lobed mixer nozzles for supersonic and subsonic aircraft, variable noise reduction systems for supersonic aircraft, and a real time sonic boom warning system. These areas reflect a focus on aerodynamic efficiency, propulsion, noise mitigation, and operational safety.

overview_description.description:
Boom Supersonic is a commercial airplane manufacturer that builds 65- to 88-seat supersonic airliners.

Boom Technology is making supersonic passenger travel into reality by making a supersonic airliner. Boom was founded on the philosophy that they need to overcome the challenges to supersonic passenger flight, not surrender to them. They're making supersonic aircraft affordable for business travel. Their ultimate goal is a routine supersonic flight for everyone.

Boom Supersonic is redefining what it means to fly in a commercial aircraft by building Overture, its Mach-2.2.

about_short_description.short_description: Boom Supersonic is a commercial airplane manufacturer that builds supersonic airliners designed for speed, safety, and sustainability.

product.name: Overture
product.description: A supersonic commercial airliner designed to transport passengers between global destinations in approximately half the time of conventional airliners.

product.name: Symphony
product.description: A medium-bypass turbofan engine being developed by Boom Supersonic to power Overture and support efficient supersonic flight.

product.name: XB-1
product.description: A supersonic demonstrator aircraft used to validate technologies and flight procedures supporting the development of Overture.

product.name: Superpower
product.description: A 42-megawatt natural-gas turbine system that applies Boom’s supersonic engine technology to provide power for AI data centers.

product.name: Boomless Cruise
product.description: A supersonic flight capability designed to prevent the sonic boom from reaching the ground during suitable atmospheric and flight conditions.
